notes.title: Langoth: Wind Of Change DLC 1.1.0.0
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27859035/5185d96505233157eae415c8a5b2c33984d06464.jpg[/img]

- Added two new maps for stylized arena
- Revised design of all levels in a single game
- Now it's harder to kill enemies with conventional armor
- The radius of the explosion is set
- In the center of the blast enemies take more serious damage
- Added more bombs
- Added a new designs of the enemies
- The appearance of the enemy depends on the level
- Changed the artificial intelligence of enemies
- Fixed a rare bug with STEAM achievements not triggering
- Improved graphics on all levels
- A lot of small changes
